- 5a44560 contains two things:

It now skips the clashing namespace and counts it in `MergeReport.ns_skipped`. Docs with the same id but different text are counted in `MergeReport.doc_conflicts` (local copy kept, as before). `meshstore merge` prints both. The new test fails on the old code.
  - B23 py changes: the strict-`>` rank counting fixes (see below).
